verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official, scriptable CLI, nitropy. A runtime probe confirms it installs from PyPI and identifies itself as a 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices', and it has a dedicated docs page. However, the evidence never documents the specific management operations the story names. Missing for 10: documented commands for enabling or disabling applications, setting or changing PINs, managing slots, reading device state or status, and hands-on corroboration of scripted management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably

citations.quote: Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices
